text:
The Ducks come to New Jersey stuck. They lost 3-2 at the Islanders on Tuesday, their fourth straight without a win (0-4-0), and they are 1-4-0 in their last five. They're also playing without Ryan Poehling (lower body, on injured reserve). Leo Carlsson has moved onto his line beside Nesterenko and Killorn, and Nikita Klepov and Judd Caulfield are playing more. Caulfield is now day-to-day and could return. The Devils beat Colorado 4-3 on Tuesday and are 3-2-0 in their last five.

The play has favored New Jersey. At five on five, the Devils have taken 61% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) and the Ducks 43%. Anaheim also takes 4.2 penalties a game, which keeps handing opponents power plays. Both goalies are backups tonight: Ville Husso (projected) is +0.9 goals saved above expected this season, while Nico Daws (projected) is at -2.7.

Jack Hughes is the Devils' top watch, with a 37% chance to score and 73% for a point. Nico Hischier, on the top power play, is at 31% to score. For Anaheim, Cutter Gauthier is at 34% to score. Luke Evangelista is one assist from 100 career assists. Ice Sheet's under-the-radar pick is Timo Meier, a third-liner with dangerous shots lately (3.1 expected goals in his last nine games); we have him at 24% to score.
